integrity: Analytical proof and finite independent quadrature diagnostic supplied; no independent audit or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The result assumes one-dimensional OU diffusion with positive parameters and equal-probability independent Poisson resets to exactly two symmetric sites. It does not cover unequal reset weights, non-Poisson renewal clocks, arbitrary confining potentials or transient modes. Numerical tests are finite diagnostics. Publication priority has not been externally certified.
title: A separation-independent modality transition for two-site Ornstein–Uhlenbeck resetting
